newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Soccer player shoots referee dead in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Soccer player shoots referee dead in Brazil.

text.p: An amateur soccer player who was thrown out of a neighbourhood game for foul play fatally shot the referee who expelled him, Brazilian authorities said on Monday.
Police in Cambe, a city in the southern state of Parana, said they were looking for Alexandre Rocha, 20, who fled after the Sunday shooting.

Rocha went home to pick up a pistol after being expelled from the game for a personal foul, police said. He then returned to the field while the game was still being played and pumped four rounds into referee Valmir dos Santos, 34, as horrified fans looked on.
Dos Santos died on the spot, police said.

Soccer is Brazil's national sport and neighbourhood games are held each weekend in thousands of cities and towns. Passions run high and the game often turns violent at both the amateur and professional level.
